items.title: The combined medication approach for treating overactive bladder: assessing safety and efficacy
items.summary: Research question: What is the latest evidence on the efficacy and safety of combining medications to treat overactive bladder? The problem: Overactive bladder symptoms negatively impact quality of life and, with an ageing population, overactive bladder prevalence is expected to rise.
